title: T1-T12 out-of-plane rotation ratios with true ribs (Mannen 2015)
subcategory: long segment with rib cage (true ribs)

quantity.name: coupled_ratio
quantity.definition: out-of-plane rotation ROM as % of in-plane ROM for that bending mode (per-specimen normalised, mean (SD))

source.authors: Mannen EM, Anderson JT, Arnold PM, Friis EA
source.sample: 7 fresh-frozen human T1-T12 thoracic spines with true ribs (T1-T10) and sternum, all white males

protocol.summary: T1-T12 with true ribs and sternum; T12 fixed, pure moments +/-5 Nm at T1, 1 deg/s, 5 cycles (3rd analysed), random order of modes; T1 motion vs T12 by Euler decomposition.
how_to_simulate: Model T1-T12 with ribs 1-10, costal cartilage and sternum (no floating ribs, no muscles); fix T12
Apply pure moments +/-5 Nm to T1 in FE, LB, AR without preload
Report T1 rotation relative to T12

extraction.check_notes: Re-read from text layer (Table 2 columns aligned by layout).

ribcage.intact_structures: true ribs 1-10 with costal cartilage and sternum, costovertebral joints, ligaments; floating ribs 11-12 and all muscles removed

loading.branch: 0 Nm to peak moment per direction
loading.device: novel 6-DOF spine tester, Optotrak pin in T1 potting
